protocol.status: Written before inspecting higher-redshift brightness outcomes; exploratory test, not an external preregistration
protocol.law: S=exp(kappa R); D_L=R S, Euclidean fixed spatial geometry and conserved photons
protocol.primary_selection: Pantheon+ all light-curve rows with zHD>=0.1 and IS_CALIBRATOR==0, preserving released covariance for repeated supernovae
protocol.calibration: Determine one absolute magnitude from IS_CALIBRATOR==1 using m_b_corr-CEPH_DIST and full released calibrator covariance; no higher-z brightness used for calibration
protocol.primary_distance: D_L=(1+zHEL)*ln(1+zHD)/kappa_Mpc; heliocentric factor is a conventional observer correction whose transfer to this theory is conditional
protocol.primary_covariance: Full STAT+SYS; propagate calibrator magnitude uncertainty and cross-covariance into higher-z residual covariance
protocol.reference: Flat LCDM Omega_m=0.3 and H0=c*kappa_Mpc, both fixed; reference only, not a new best fit
diagnostics: remove one constant offset as a labeled higher-z shape-only diagnostic
replace heliocentric factor with 1+zHD to quantify frame convention sensitivity
no_claims: No blind status for existing nearby test data
No post-result refitting of formula or coefficient
